messages:
lee.prod: Heads-up: we need a compact launch spec for Dedicated (reserved pools + burst behavior) to present to execs Tues. goal: one-slide acceptance checklist + rollout caveats. can we get a quick alignment here?
noah.eng: quick take: pick a conservative default autoscale profile for GA and offer an 'aggressive' profile behind a feature flag. conservative avoids noisy-tenant spikes.
emma.infra: Agree. Also enforce AZ spread limits and disallow >85% of an AZ for reserved allocations by default.
raj.sales: Pilots keep asking about hourly burst windows (vs daily) so they can smooth consumption for rate-limited products. can we support both patterns?
zoe.se: From SEs: hourly windows are useful but increase billing complexity. recommend supporting daily by GA and an hourly pilot mode for a subset of customers.
liam.finance: If hourly burst is pilot-only, finance needs expected burn numbers for both hourly and daily models for the first 6 weeks. we'll provide a simple ROI calc.
lee.prod: Draft GA acceptance checklist idea: 1) two-region latency SLOs validated with burst profiles; 2) autoscale conservative default + feature-flag aggressive profile; 3) billing line items defined (reserved_commit, burst_metered, carryover_credit); 4) telemetry hooks emitted (redwood.dedicated.prewarm.count, .spillover.count, .burst.used_tokens); 5) AZ spread and region-affinity controls; 6) documented rollback and cross-region fallback behavior.
noah.eng: Concrete autoscale defaults proposal:
```yaml
autoscale_default: conservative
conservative:
  cooldown_s: 360
  hysteresis_pct: 20
  prewarm_formula: "max(1, floor(pool_gpus * 0.15))"
aggressive:
  cooldown_s: 120
  hysteresis_pct: 8
  prewarm_formula: "max(1, ceil(pool_gpus * 0.33))"
```
emma.infra: We'll validate those formulas against current fleet. also recommend default burst_headroom = 15% of pool (opt-out per contract) and a global cap of 25% for any single region to avoid capacity concentration.
raj.sales: On carryover: customers want carryover as a paid add-on. we should model carryover_credit as a SKU and default it off. pilot opt-in only.
zoe.se: UX asks: show customers a running "burst balance" that decrements in real-time and a forecast for next refill. also show recent prewarm_evictions with timestamps.
liam.finance: We'll need the metric definitions to map to billing. propose naming: dedicated.reserved_commit_units, dedicated.burst_tokens_used, dedicated.carryover_credits_consumed.
qa-bot: Canary plan: run canary profile "burst-1.5x-mix" in us-west on 1764010000 and capture tail latencies. report will be posted to #eng-telemetry.
noah.eng: Edge-case: if a tenant sets "no-cross-region-fallback" and region capacity is exhausted, we must return 503 with clear error code and telemetry. define error code `DEDICATED_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED_LOCAL_ONLY`.
emma.infra: Agree, and we'll add a tenant flag `region_affinity: strict|default` with default=default. document behavior in the runbook.
lee.prod: Rollout plan sketch: GA -> pilot customers get feature flags for hourly-burst and carryover opt-in; GA public gets daily-burst + conservative autoscale. post-GA roadmap: hourly-burst standard, tiered carryover pricing, UI refinements.
raj.sales: Action: I'll confirm 4 pilot customers and note which need hourly windows vs daily. due Thu.
noah.eng: Action: I'll run a simulation for conservative and aggressive profiles across typical tenant mixes and post results. due Wed EOD.
emma.infra: Action: capacity sims for us-west/eu-west including AZ spread and 25% regional cap. due Wed noon.
zoe.se: Action: mockups for burst balance UI + prewarm_evictions list. due Thu EOD.
liam.finance: Action: provide billing mapping and quick overage model for pilot pricing. due Fri AM.
lee.prod: If all green, I'll put the one-page acceptance checklist in the roadmap deck by Monday. If not, we push hourly/carryover to post-GA. thanks all. :tada:
__notes: Slack thread concatenated messages per agents.md; short, realistic channel discussion about Dedicated roadmap and launch gates
